gaps: Live response fields confirmed for get_account_status, list_scheduled_pins, list_pinterest_profiles, list_connected_stores and list_store_products; list_automations item fields, get_post_content and list_templates field names remain unverified

novel_features.name: Post to pin
novel_features.description: Turn a blog post URL into a scheduled Pinterest pin in one command, previewed for free before any credit is spent.
novel_features.rationale: Chains post extraction into pin generation with a credit guard and a local spend ledger that the vendor's MCP tools do not provide.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent must pin a specific post; it previews cost and skips posts this CLI already pinned (spend ledger). Use unpinned-posts to check the account's queue first.

novel_features.name: Plan preflight
novel_features.description: Price a planned batch in credits and confirm the profile, board and design profile exist before spending anything.
novel_features.rationale: Combines a credit cost table with live account, profile, board and design-profile reads; no single tool answers whether a plan will succeed.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this before any --execute batch so a bad board ID or low balance fails free.

novel_features.name: Products to pins
novel_features.description: Turn a connected store's products into a batch of scheduled pins, skipping products this CLI already pinned (spend ledger).
novel_features.rationale: Pages through store products and plans one pin per product against a local ledger, which the vendor tools leave to manual repetition.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this for e-commerce pinning in bulk; the dry run shows the total credit cost first.

novel_features.name: Unpinned posts
novel_features.description: List sitemap posts that have no scheduled pin and no ledgered spend.
novel_features.rationale: Joins sitemap posts with the scheduled-pin queue and the local ledger; no single tool can answer it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Start a blog-to-pins run here so only new posts get pinned.

novel_features.name: Spend ledger
novel_features.description: See every credit-spending call this CLI executed, including unconfirmed ones that may have spent, with totals by tool and time window.
novel_features.rationale: The MCP surface exposes no spend history; the ledger is local state written by --execute paths.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Check this after an agent run, or before a retry; an unconfirmed entry means check list-scheduled-pins before trying again.

novel_features.name: Queue gaps
novel_features.description: Find empty and overloaded days in the scheduled-pin queue, per board.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates the scheduled-pin list by day and board, which the raw list does not show.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to keep a steady posting cadence across client accounts.

novel_features.name: Credit runway
novel_features.description: Estimate weekly credit burn from active automations and how many days of credit remain.
novel_features.rationale: Joins automation cadence with the account balance; Pin Generator shows neither forecast.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run weekly for accounts with automations so batches do not fail on an empty balance.

narrative.headline: Every Pin Generator MCP tool as a typed command, with credit-safe dry runs, preflight pricing and a local spend ledger.
narrative.value_prop: Drive Pin Generator from scripts and agents: discover profiles and boards, turn posts or store products into pins with pin-post and pin-products, and check plans with preflight before spending. Anything that costs credits previews for free until you pass --execute.
narrative.auth_narrative: Pin Generator's account access key (pingenerator.com/profile, API access key) authorizes the MCP endpoint as a Bearer token. Set PINGENERATOR_ACCESS_KEY. The web app's richer REST API needs a Firebase login session and is not used.

quickstart.comment: Confirms the CLI runs offline; then run get-account-status to check your key
Board IDs you will schedule into
Posts that still need a pin
Free preview; add --execute to spend 1 credit and schedule

troubleshoots.symptom: Exit code 4: no access key, or user not found
troubleshoots.fix: Set PINGENERATOR_ACCESS_KEY to the API access key from pingenerator.com/profile, or run pingenerator-pp-cli auth set-token
Run pingenerator-pp-cli credit-runway, then top up credits in the Pin Generator app
Space out batch loops; the prior CLI observed a limit of about 60 requests per minute per key

troubleshoots.symptom: A generate, schedule or create-automation command printed a request but nothing happened
troubleshoots.fix: That was the free preview; re-run with --execute to spend credits

troubleshoots.symptom: The ledger shows an unconfirmed spend
troubleshoots.fix: Run pingenerator-pp-cli list-scheduled-pins to see whether the pin exists before retrying

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI when an agent or script needs to create, schedule or automate Pinterest pins through a Pin Generator account: blog posts to pins, store products to pins, design profiles, recurring automations, and queue or credit checks. Every credit-spending command, including create-automation and run-automation-batch, prints a free preview until --execute is passed; a preview has "dry_run": true (typed tools) or "executed": false (pin-post), so check those fields before reporting that anything was scheduled. Design-profile setup and updates change account state immediately but spend no credits; use --dry-run to preview them. get_account_status, list_scheduled_pins and list_pinterest_profiles response fields were confirmed live; other tools' response fields are parsed tolerantly.
anti_triggers: Reading Pinterest analytics, impressions or saves; use a Pinterest API CLI instead
Editing or deleting a pin that is already scheduled; Pin Generator exposes no tool for it
Managing Pinterest boards directly; Pin Generator only lists and AI-creates boards during scheduling
